properties.areaDesc: Municipality of Skagway; Haines Borough and Klukwan
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 19 at 7:51PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
properties.description:
A strong storm system is expected to move into the northern half of
the Alaska Panhandle and the northeast Gulf Coast tonight and
continue through Tuesday. Beginning tonight for Haines, Skagway, and
the two highways, periods of moderate to heavy rain will move over
the area. Total rain accumulation are expected to be between 1.5-3.5
inches, with the heaviest rain late Tuesday morning into Tuesday
afternoon. While substantial areal flooding is not expected at this
time, isolated instances of minor ponding of water in low lying
areas are possible. Furthermore, wet snow is possibly on the
Klondike Highway near White Pass up to 3 inches through tonight,
though warm surface temperatures may hinder these snow totals.

NWSheadline: HEAVY RAIN EXPECTED MONDAY NIGHT THROUGH TUESDAY

properties.areaDesc: Rabun; Habersham; Stephens; Franklin; Hart; Elbert
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 19 at 11:44PM EDT by NWS Greenville-Spartanburg SC
properties.description:
Low relative humidity is forecasted again today. Relative
humidity will fall below 25 percent for much of the afternoon,
especially for northeast Georgia. Given the dry vegetation,
outdoor fires will be able to spread quickly once started,
increasing the danger of wildfires.

Please refer to your local burn permitting authorities on whether
you can burn today. If you do burn, use extreme caution since
fires can quickly get out of hand under these conditions.

NWSheadline: INCREASED FIRE DANGER FROM TUESDAY AFTERNOON THROUGH TUESDAY EVENING
